_note: Console-only (kernel SAFETY_COMPONENTS and the push gate list this file). VM2 plugs in HERE and nowhere else. Fill viewer_url and control_url with the VM2 Tailscale address (100.x.y.z or name.tailnet.ts.net) and set enabled to true once the viewer and the hub route are up (docs/03_DECISIONS.md D79, jarvis/lab/deploy/VM2_DESKTOP.md). NEVER put a password, token or key in any address: the viewer asks for its own password, which only you know. An address with a user name, a password, a token or a non-Tailscale host is dropped.
